component: ZenDB v2.0.1 M1 bounded synthetic benchmark
status: EXECUTED 2026-10-28: the updated exact pinned harness passed on a fresh ephemeral local DFX replica. It is bounded synthetic diagnostic evidence only; it records actual cycle deltas and verifies the declared ceilings for this fixture, including bounded cross-canister archive delivery, but does not establish the remaining M1 operation or crash/upgrade recovery proofs.

runner.networkBoundary: The runner does not invoke `mops install`, because that Mops CLI command performs an unrelated ICP API compatibility call before it resolves the pinned lock. It configures an ephemeral project-local loopback bind address, pings that local replica before any canister creation, and every create/build/deploy/call command specifies `--network local`; creation also uses `--no-wallet`.

bounded caller-to-ZenDB write bytes and one-document recovery-read bytes

cycleBudgetHarness.boundary: fresh ephemeral project-local DFX replica; synthetic data only; no wallet or remote network
cycleBudgetHarness.cycleMeasurement: The fixture reads its own canister cycle balance immediately before and after each insert batch, logical-ID query, replacement, delete/recreate repair-index operation, and deletion. A balance increase or a delta above the declared ceiling traps the run.
cycleBudgetHarness.resultHandling: The runner writes the returned Candid metrics, including every cycle delta, to a mode-0600 benchmark-result.did file in its isolated work directory. The 2026-10-28 execution below is the reviewed result for this harness.
